correctness.rationale: For a full-support mu_6 phase word f on Z7, Q(zeta_6) and Q(zeta_7) are disjoint, so an off-axis frequency zero at k!=0 forces the seven coefficients h_x(t)=f(t)conj(f(t-x)) all equal. For x!=0 the product gives c^7=1 and c in mu_6, hence c=1 and f is constant. Nonconstant words thus have 36 nonzero off-axis values; A(0,0)=7 and A(0,k!=0)=0, while shift-axis zeros occur only in three conjugate pairs. Integer coordinates of zeta_6 yield exact zero tests. Independently enumerated every one of the 6^6=46656 normalized exponent words, recovering masks 0:41868, single masks 1/2/4:1512 each, double masks 3/5/6:84 each, triple mask7:0; hence support distribution 7:1,39:252,41:4536,43:41867. Independently reconstructed the affine-index/conjugation orbits of the four provided representatives, sizes 84,42,84,42, pairwise disjoint, exactly union of all 252 double-mask words. Inspected RESULT.md, verify_support.py and independent verify_increments.py at exact frozen blobs; this is a complete finite enumeration, not extrapolation to other lengths.
